app.setup.title_default.why: Terse status line, no verb needed, matches System Settings register.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged wording distinct from the plain not-yet-on state above.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Setelah aktif, situs tak bisa lagi membajak klikmu.
app.setup.detail_default.back: Once active, sites can no longer hijack your click.
app.setup.detail_default.why: One active-verb sentence; -mu carries the kamu address without a bare pronoun.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Safari tak bisa memastikan status ekstensi. Aktifkan saja, aplikasi ini akan tahu sendiri.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: Safari can't confirm the extension's status. Just turn it on, this app will know by itself.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: No error code, two plain clauses, reassures without technical detail.

app.setup.open_button.why: Fits the width budget; Safari is dropped since both screens are already about Safari.

app.welcome.heading.why: The one place allowed a warmer register; keeps the product name untranslated.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Plain noun phrase naming the trick, no marketing flourish.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Lapisan tak terlihat bisa menutupi halaman dan mengubah arah klikmu.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: An invisible layer can cover the page and change the direction of your click.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Two verbs joined with dan instead of a participle tail.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Two-word noun label, stative adjective is fine outside a full sentence.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Sebagian situs mengganti tujuan tautan tepat saat kamu menekannya.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some sites change a link's destination right as you press it.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Active verb mengganti, explicit kamu for the moment of pressing.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Tab baru hanya terbuka ke tujuan yang kamu tekan, tidak ada yang menyelinap.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: A new tab only opens to the destination you pressed, nothing sneaks in.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Stated as a promise about what the guard guarantees, comma instead of a dash.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Names the feature: tracked, not only the ones caught.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Tiap tujuan tercatat, dan kamu bisa mengizinkannya atau memblokirnya, di sini atau di semua situs.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination is recorded, and you can allow or block it, here or on every site.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Reuses the scope pair di sini / di semua situs used throughout the extension copy.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Names the on-mechanism: per site, not automatic.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Tekan tombol Undirect di bilah alat Safari untuk mengaktifkan pelindung di situs itu.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Press the Undirect button in Safari's toolbar to activate the guard on that site.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: bilah alat is Apple's own Indonesian for toolbar; Pelindung is the fixed term for the guard.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Two words, fits a narrow sidebar column and works as a nav title.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own Indonesian term for this screen, not a synonym.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Short form of the everywhere concept (semua situs), one word to pair against Per Situs.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Reads as the clear opposite of Semua beside it.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.back: No data yet from the extension
app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: Names this as a first-contact state, not a content-is-empty state.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Buka satu halaman di Safari, layar ini akan terisi sendiri.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open one page in Safari, this screen will fill itself.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: Names the simple fix; shared verbatim with the Guarded Sites screen.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Distinct wording from the no-data-yet title above.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Tujuan muncul di sini begitu kamu mengizinkan atau memblokirnya.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: A destination appears here once you allow or block it.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains that seeing alone does not create a rule, deciding does.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Placeholder kept literal; Indonesian has no plural agreement, so this one form covers every count.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: Fixed state word for the blocked verdict, used across app and extension rows.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Imperative verb form, distinct from the state word Diizinkan shown elsewhere.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: Pilih izinkan atau blokir tujuan ini.
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: Choose allow or block for this destination.
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Short hover phrase naming what the control does.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: bawaan is the fixed term for default policy throughout; this clears the rule rather than setting a new verdict.

app.watched.empty.title.why: Plain statement that no site has been switched on.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Tekan tombol Undirect di bilah alat Safari pada situs yang bermasalah.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Press the Undirect button in Safari's toolbar on a problem site.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Concrete instruction for the very first guarded site.

app.watched.footer.s: Situs baru masuk daftar ini hanya lewat tombol Undirect di Safari.
app.watched.footer.back: New sites enter this list only through the Undirect button in Safari.
app.watched.footer.why: Active subject (situs baru masuk) instead of a passive ditambahkan.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb for the trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.back: Turn off the guard for this site.
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Names the action the Stop button performs.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: Fixed noun for the guard concept, used as the master switch's own name.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state word reused for more than one setting on this screen.

app.settings.state_off.why: EYD one-word form, generic off-state word.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Introduces the choice of which sites the guard actually runs on.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's own point of view, -mu carries the kamu address.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Fixed everywhere-scope phrase, contrasts cleanly with Situs Pilihanmu.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Names the on-page banner, separate from the popup's own record.

app.settings.policy_heading.why: Introduces the default-policy choice for a destination with no rule yet.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Picker option; the heading above already frames this as the default.

ext.meta.description.s: Menghentikan halaman yang membajak klikmu untuk membuka situs lain tanpa izin.
ext.meta.description.back: Stops pages that hijack your click to open another site without permission.
ext.meta.description.why: One sentence for someone who has never used the extension; active verb, no jargon.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name, same proper noun.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the current tab's guard state as the tooltip.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as a call to action; comma instead of a dash.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains there is nothing to guard on this tab.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Headline for the no-site empty state.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: Buka situs web, lalu tekan di sini untuk menjaganya.
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Open a website, then press here to guard it.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: Keeps 'here' as a self-reference to the button the popup hangs off, per the brief's note.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: Aktifkan atau matikan pelindung di situs ini
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: Turn the guard on or off on this site
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader-only label naming what the switch controls.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.s: Tak ada halaman untuk dijaga di sini.
ext.popup.watch_unknown.back: There's no page to guard here.
ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Explains why the switch is disabled: nothing to guard.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.s: Pelindung sudah aktif di semua situs.
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.back: The guard is already active on every site.
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the switch is redundant because everywhere-mode is already on.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.back: The guard is currently turned off.
ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Attributes the disabled switch to the master toggle, not this site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: Aktif di sini. Mematikannya memuat ulang halaman.
ext.popup.watch_on.back: Active here. Turning it off reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms state and warns of the reload in one short pair of clauses.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: Nonaktif di sini. Mengaktifkannya memuat ulang halaman.
ext.popup.watch_off.back: Off here. Turning it on reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct before/after counterpart to watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Heads the list of what the current tab specifically reached for.

ext.popup.page_off.s: Tak ada yang dipantau, pelindung mati di sini.
ext.popup.page_off.back: Nothing being monitored, guard is off here.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22, not called from any code; kept speculative and thin.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Belum ada yang mencoba keluar dari halaman ini.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: Nothing has tried to leave this page yet.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly that nothing has reached outside this page so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.s: Belum ada yang tercatat di sini.
ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22; treated as a near-synonym of page_quiet, not code-driven.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Singular unit of a plural pair; Indonesian has no plural agreement so this text is identical to stopped_other.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Plural unit of the same pair; kept as a separate translation unit but reads identically, since Indonesian marks plurality by number word, not word form.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Singular unit; broader than stopped, counts everything recorded regardless of verdict.

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Plural unit, same text as seen_one for the same no-plural-agreement reason.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse per-destination fragment meant to sit among other short fragments in one detail line.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Plural unit, same text as tries_one for the same no-plural-agreement reason.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Prefix fragment: 'Perbaikan: <nama perbaikan>' reads naturally as a lead-in.

ext.state.blocked.why: Same fixed word as app.rules.row.state_blocked; combines with scope fragments below (Diblokir di sini, Diblokir di semua situs).

ext.state.allowed.why: Clear opposite of Diblokir, same combination rule.

ext.state.removed.why: For a local trap with no destination to rule on, distinct from the allow/block pair.

ext.scope.here.why: Fragment following a verdict word: Diblokir di sini.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Fragment following a verdict word: Diblokir di semua situs.

ext.scope.default.why: Fragment following a verdict word: Diblokir secara bawaan; bawaan is the fixed default term.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Complete menu option, scoped to the current site.

ext.action.block_here.why: Complete menu option, scoped to the current site.

ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same heading as the app's equivalent screen, separate translation unit.

ext.policy.block.why: Radio option, consistent with the app's policy_block.

ext.policy.allow.why: Radio option, consistent with the app's policy_allow.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Keamanan halaman ini memblokir sebagian pelindung; perlindungan di sini tak lengkap.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's security blocks part of the guard; protection here isn't complete.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Names it as a limitation of this one page, not a bug or a setting to fix.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Short noun-phrase tag for the invisible clickable element trick.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than click_catcher: any see-through element over the page.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a click the page's own code dispatched, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: pop-up kept as the common loan term for this trick.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Names a navigation fired right after the browser back gesture.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab-redirect trick this whole extension exists to stop.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Names a tab-under style new tab opened behind the person's press.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the strongest, earliest kind of block, before the page ever loaded it.

ext.reason.way_back.back: Its address carries a way back.
ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains the redirect's own address included a path back to the starting site.

ext.reason.sized.back: The window opened at a specific size.
ext.reason.sized.why: Explains the window read as an intentional secondary window, not a hijack.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Names the core hijack pattern: it rode a press aimed elsewhere, distinct from generic membajak.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: bawaan is the fixed default term; explains it went through with no rule against it.

ext.reason.own_code.back: Opened by the site's own code.
ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains the site's own script vouched for the window.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: One word, reused as nav row, header title, and back-button accessibility label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Names the destination (the popup's main per-page view) a chevron-only back button returns to.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Fixed everywhere-scope phrase used consistently across the extension.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Clear counterpart to Semua Situs above it.

ext.rules.empty.why: One-word placeholder row for an empty rule section.

ext.action.allow.why: Scope is already fixed by the section this row sits in.

ext.action.block.why: Scope is already fixed by the section this row sits in.

ext.action.clear.why: Removes the explicit rule entirely, reads as the same action as app.rules.row.use_default.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Apple's own Indonesian term; separate translation unit from the app's Settings screen but the same word.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Fixed noun for the master guard switch, used both visibly and as the sr-only label.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: State word specific to the guard switch.

ext.settings.mode_heading.why: Same heading as the app's equivalent, separate translation unit.

ext.settings.mode_watched.why: Consistent with the app's mode_watched, -mu keeps the kamu address.

ext.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Fixed everywhere-scope phrase, consistent with the app's mode_everywhere.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Shorter form of the app's Catatan di Halaman to fit the tighter popup budget.

ext.action.report.why: Names the action of opening a pre-filled issue report; nothing is sent until the person submits it themselves.
